quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology 2025 revenue RMB 12,436,536,572.55, up 59.33% (2024: RMB 7,805,445,697.44); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 112,522,522.31, up 145.91% (2024: a loss of RMB 245,110,031.26); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 83,429,951.34, up 135.24%; operating cash flow RMB -381,332,043.56. Quarterly revenue Q1 RMB 2,500,567,347.01, Q2 RMB 2,798,825,229.27, Q3 RMB 3,200,716,671.55, Q4 RMB 3,936,427,324.72; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 45,928,416.92. The company attributes the result to a marked recovery in downstream demand that lifted shipments, a higher share of high-value-added lithium-battery and electronic-circuit foil that raised the average processing fee, and much higher capacity utilisation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology 2025 revenue by product: lithium-battery copper foil RMB 10,025,598,879.08 (80.61% of revenue, up 77.61%), gross margin 7.64% (up 3.81 pt); electronic-circuit copper foil RMB 1,781,064,728.66 (14.32% of revenue, down 1.55%; 23.18% in 2024), gross margin 3.67% (up 4.82 pt); other RMB 629,872,964.81. Electrolytic copper foil output 139,585 tons (up 50.33%), sales 140,892 tons (up 51.99%), year-end inventory 3,436 tons (down 27.56%, inventory-reduction measures). Raw materials were 87.61% of electronic-circuit foil cost and 89.06% of lithium-battery foil cost.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology capacity: built capacity was 17.5 ten-thousand tons per year at the end of 2025, which the company places in the first tier of domestic-funded copper-foil makers. The company says it has run at full production since the fourth quarter of 2025, with strong downstream new-energy demand plus strong demand for high-end electronic-circuit foil from AI, 5G/6G communications and low-earth-orbit satellites, and that in 2026 it will add capacity by building new high-end lines and integrating existing capacity in the market.
quarterly_data.figure: built capacity 17.5 ten-thousand tons per year (end-2025); full production since Q4 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology high-end electronic-circuit copper foil status (2025 annual report): RTF-3 and RTF-4 reverse-treated foils passed certification at several leading CCL makers and are in batch supply for high-speed servers, Mini LED packaging and AI accelerator cards; its self-developed carrier copper foil C-IC2 is in mass production in a 1.6T optical-module project; 9-12 micron ultra-thin foil for SLP-type substrates fits BT / BT-like boards with 40/40 micron line/space. HVLP1-3 are in batch supply, which the report says are mainly used in NVIDIA projects and optical modules (elsewhere: high-end AI servers, high-end switches and optical modules); HVLP4 is ramping in small volume at some customers; HVLP5 has completed sample certification and customer introduction is under way. The R&D table lists HVLP4 foil (12-35 micron, treated-side Rz 0.8 micron or less) and ultra-thin peelable carrier foil for IC packaging (copper layer 5 micron or less, for package substrates and optical modules) as batch delivered, and a high-temperature high-elongation foil for substrate-like packaging (memory chips) as having completed end-customer validation.
quarterly_data.figure: HVLP1-3 batch supply; HVLP4 small-volume ramp; HVLP5 sample certification complete; C-IC2 carrier foil in mass production (1.6T optical modules)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology 2025 R&D spend RMB 200,227,650.68 (up 9.37%), 1.61% of revenue (2.35% in 2024), none capitalised; 453 R&D staff (14.65% of employees), 77 new patents. In lithium-battery foil it mass-produces 3 to 10 micron double-sided foil, with 4.5 micron and ultra-high-strength (tensile strength above 700MPa) foil in stable batch delivery to several leading customers, and new porous (PCF), atomised and 'core' foils for solid-state and lithium-metal batteries that it says are production-ready.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiujiang Defu Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jiujiang Defu Technology business plan (2025 annual report, company outlook): in electronic-circuit foil it will pursue differentiation toward high-compute equipment, low-earth-orbit satellites and embodied intelligence, speed import substitution in high-frequency / high-speed, fine-line and flexible boards, deepen strategic cooperation with leading CCL and PCB makers and raise the share of high-end products; it will speed its entry into the supplier systems of strategic overseas customers in Taiwan, Japan, South Korea and Southeast Asia; and it plans to raise capacity over the next few years in an orderly way through new high-end lines and integration of existing market capacity. To counter falling processing fees it plans to push volume production of 5 micron and thinner lithium-battery foil and speed customer certification and shipments of HVLP and RTF foil.
